title: Commercial Content SaaS Jingying Tech Raises Multi-Hundred-Thousand RMB Seed+ from Zizhu Xiaomiao
summary: On Oct 24, 2022, commercial short-video human+AI SaaS Jingying Tech (井英科技) closed a multi-hundred-thousand RMB Seed+ from Zizhu Xiaomiao Fund for AI R&D, scene digital-human modeling, and GTM; next round already opening. Founded Jun 2021; PLG for creators + advertisers. CEO Zhu

html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · October 25, 2022

On Oct 24, 2022, commercial short-video human+AI SaaS Jingying Tech (井英科技) closed a multi-hundred-thousand RMB Seed+ from Zizhu Xiaomiao Fund for AI R&D, scene digital-human modeling, and GTM; next round already opening. Founded Jun 2021; PLG for creators + advertisers. CEO Zhu Jiang (ex-TouchPal CGO, SJTU CS); go-global marketing veterans.

Overseas brand CreativeFitting: one-stop “foreign real-person” short-video production for TikTok ads — AI script assistant (cuts >80% drafting time from 10k+ hit oral scripts) + scene digital humans in 50+ countries/languages. TikTok overseas marketing ~$4B prior year mostly ads. Client mix ~80% go-global; hit ads on TikTok creative leaderboards (e.g. ecom clip 8k+ likes, top-5% conversion). Thesis: AI+human beats pure-AI quality and pure-human scale.

— END —
